parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the current Spark instance.

parameters.name: DbClusterIds
parameters.description: The instance ID of the cluster to associate.

parameters.name: RelateDbType
parameters.description:
The type of database to associate. Valid values:
- **hdfs**
- **hbase**
- **mongodb**
- **mysql**
- **polardb_mysql**
- **redis**
- **geomesa**.
